stations.title: Ivo
stations.say: Can it show this week's workshops?

captions: Ivo wants the sign-up screen to show this week's workshops from the studio's API.
Nothing asks the API yet, so the screen says there are no workshops at all.
You ask once when the screen opens, draw a card each, and wait before saying empty.
Now the week's five workshops arrive and each gets its own card.
Same five workshops, on screen, and never a false empty week while they travel.
